note: Baseline for `npm run audit:coverage`. Keys are stable and carry no line numbers, so unrelated edits do not invalidate them. "exclusions" are permanent and hand-written — the finding is a false positive or the source is correct as-is — and are never rewritten by --update; always give a reason. "accepted" is a snapshot of outstanding work and is regenerated by --update, so entries disappear as the backlog is cleared.

exclusions.stale-param|WorldAssembly/Source/NexusWo: False positive (parser pitfall 4): SocketUnitSize IS a constructor parameter. The parameter list is terminated by the N_ASSEMBLY_ANALYTICS_CONSTRUCTOR macro rather than a plain `)`, so the signature parser stops early and never sees the third parameter. The same shape appears on every FN*Task constructor that takes analytics.
